entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I entered the study and shifted..."
entries.dialogueText: As I entered the study and shifted my gaze toward the window, the sudden extinguishing of the lights at the palace gates drew my attention.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tossed and turned all night. Desp..."
entries.dialogueText: I tossed and turned all night. Despite the exhaustion of a busy day, sleep eluded me entirely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the hope of clearing my mind, I..."
entries.dialogueText: In the hope of clearing my mind, I got out of bed and made my way through the palace corridors to my study.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before evening fell, I had received..."
entries.dialogueText: Before evening fell, I had received news of my sister-in-law's speech at the Alliance of Nations, openly threatening Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As her ally, I feared the repercuss..."
entries.dialogueText: As her ally, I feared the repercussions her actions might bring to the Kingdom.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite distancing ourselves from R..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite distancing ourselves from Rumburg, I feared the repercussions her actions might have on our region of Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While she assured me earlier that s..."
entries.dialogueText: While she assured me earlier that she didn't intend to go to war, her speech was making headlines in Rizia, sparking questions about our position in the event of a conflict.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew she desired war from the sta..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew she desired war from the start. And her unprecedented speech was now making headlines in Rizia, sparking questions about our position in the event of a conflict.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stood up and approached the windo..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up and approached the window to take a closer look.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Not giving it a second thought, I m..."
entries.dialogueText: Not giving it a second thought, I moved to my desk and started looking through my recent correspondence.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I strained to discern anything in t..."
entries.dialogueText: I strained to discern anything in the dark, only to realize that the entire palace gardens had turned pitch-black.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And then, out of nowhere, I caught..."
entries.dialogueText: And then, out of nowhere, I caught sight of large shadows hurtling from the gates toward the palace at full speed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kept my eyes fixed on the shapes..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept my eyes fixed on the shapes as they approached.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stepped outside my chambers and a..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped outside my chambers and alerted two Wruhec's Guardian sentries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I rummaged through the papers on..."
entries.dialogueText: As I rummaged through the papers on my desk, I heard the hum of engines outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was then that the sound of roari..."
entries.dialogueText: It was then that the sound of roaring engines filled the air.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stood up and moved toward the win..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up and moved toward the window to get a closer look.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ignored the noise and kept lookin..."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored the noise and kept looking at the letters.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Turning back toward the window, I s..."
entries.dialogueText: Turning back toward the window, I saw armored personnel carriers with mounted guns. Their headlights were shining straight up at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several pairs of headlights suddenl..."
entries.dialogueText: Several pairs of headlights suddenly pierced the darkness. They belonged to armored personnel carriers with mounted guns.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of a sudden, the doors swung op..."
entries.dialogueText: All of a sudden, the doors swung open. Sevrio and several Wruhec's Guardians hurried in, visibly relieved to see me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With an abrupt thud, the doors open..."
entries.dialogueText: With an abrupt thud, the doors opened and my guards rushed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wearing puzzled expressions, the gu..."
entries.dialogueText: Wearing puzzled expressions, the guards gestured at the vehicles outside, specifically pointing to the flags on them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the coat of arms of House Az..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the coat of arms of House Azaro.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the coat of arms of House To..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the coat of arms of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was the coat of arms of House Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: It was the coat of arms of House Sazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind the leading vehicles, I also..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind the leading vehicles, I also noticed the flags of House Toras and Sazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind the leading vehicles, I also..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind the leading vehicles, I also noticed the flags of House Toras.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind the leading vehicles, I also..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind the leading vehicles, I also noticed the flags of House Sazon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we attempted to figure out what..."
entries.dialogueText: As we attempted to figure out what was happening, the guards informed me that their radio had stopped picking up any signal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several cars from the Porte Drazon..."
entries.dialogueText: Several cars from the Porte Drazon Police Department barreled through the gates, sirens blaring.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus anxiously punched a code on h..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus anxiously punched a code on his radio and held it to his ear.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean the radio doesn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean the radio doesn't work? Go and tell the other guards what's happening! Now!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go and make sure my mother is safe.""
entries.dialogueText: "Go and make sure my mother is safe."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't go anywhere. Stay with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't go anywhere. Stay with me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards, shouting "Yes, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards, shouting "Yes, Your Majesty," readied their weapons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, a man outside in fu..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, a man outside in full military uniform seized a megaphone and began to speak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Romus Toras. We have Palas Rezna c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus Toras. We have Palas Rezna completely surrounded."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Angelica Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Angelica Sazon, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Lucita Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Lucita Azaro, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Taddeus Aza..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Taddeus Azaro, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Hugo Toras,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Hugo Toras, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Abdicate the throne to Ricardus To..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abdicate the throne to Ricardus Toras, and your life and noble status will be spared."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""He's just been released from priso..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's just been released from prison, and shall be recognized as the true King of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I'll say it again. If you abdicate..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll say it again. If you abdicate, your noble status will be preserved. All we ask is that you step down in peace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""I repeat. If you abdicate, your no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I repeat. If you abdicate, your noble status will be preserved. All we ask is that you step down in peace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His words resonated in my skull."
entries.dialogueText: His words resonated in my skull.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards cast nervous glances my..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards cast nervous glances my way, waiting for instructions.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "While she assured me it was the Sor..."
entries.dialogueText: While she assured me it was the Sords who were readying for war and not Rumburg, I knew that she wanted to attack Sordland from the start.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was at that moment that Titus, a..."
entries.dialogueText: It was at that moment that Titus, accompanied by a group of guardsmen, rushed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was at that moment my mother and..."
entries.dialogueText: It was at that moment my mother and Vina, accompanied by the guards, rushed in.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was at that moment that my mothe..."
entries.dialogueText: It was at that moment that my mother, accompanied by the guards, rushed in.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty!""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The Golden Guard has taken their p..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Golden Guard has taken their positions and are prepared to defend the palace."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What are your orders?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are your orders?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's a wrap on your reign, darli..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a wrap on your reign, darling. Don't say I didn't warn you."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""That's a wrap on your reign, darli..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a wrap on your reign, darling. Don't say I didn't warn you."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father. Is this really happening?""
entries.dialogueText: "Father. Is this really happening?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Although I imagined something a li..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although I imagined something a little more subtle than this..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What are you going to do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you going to do?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's complexion paled noticeably..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's complexion paled noticeably as she caught sight of the armored vehicles.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I must address their demands.""
entries.dialogueText: "I must address their demands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing. I'm afraid I have no choi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing. I'm afraid I have no choice but to do as they say."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fight back. Guards! Get in positio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fight back. Guards! Get in position and open fire!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. Tell them to open fire!""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Tell them to open fire!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have a choice. We must lis..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have a choice. We must listen to the rebels' demands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me talk to them.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me talk to them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have to get my family out of h..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have to get my family out of here this instant. In the meantime, I will talk to the soldiers."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm going to go out and talk to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to go out and talk to them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We hold our ground, no exceptions...."
entries.dialogueText: "We hold our ground, no exceptions. Is that understood? Now open fire!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers saluted me as I grabbe..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers saluted me as I grabbed a coat and walked out on the balcony.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Are you suggesting we negotiate? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you suggesting we negotiate? I'm sorry, sir, but I doubt the enemy is receptive to your arguments."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Given our limited numbers, we don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given our limited numbers, we don't stand a chance. There's no other way out of this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know. However, while they'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. However, while they're focusing on me, you can better assess the situation and determine the best course of action."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It will buy us time. While their a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will buy us time. While their attention is on me, you can catch them off guard and ambush them."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He saluted as I grabbed a coat and..."
entries.dialogueText: He saluted as I grabbed a coat and stepped out onto the balcony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother and daughter watched in w..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother and daughter watched in wordless terror as I grabbed a coat and stepped out onto the balcony.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus. Please think before you do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus. Please think before you do or say anything stupid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a distraction. While I'm talk..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a distraction. While I'm talking to the rebels, Titus will coordinate everyone's position and commence firing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have to do this to save our fami..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to do this to save our family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. I'll be right back.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I'll be right back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Talking to them should distract th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Talking to them should distract them long enough for you to make your escape from the palace. Is that clear?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon catching sight of me, the insu..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon catching sight of me, the insurgents outside displayed a mix of astonishment and relief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen carefully. Take your weapon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Listen carefully. Take your weapons and depart from my palace, and I will disregard this... misunderstanding. You still have the opportunity to withdraw."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where the hell is my cousin? You'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the hell is my cousin? You're carrying out the orders of someone who lacks the courage to confront me directly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where the hell is my uncle? You're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the hell is my uncle? You're carrying out the orders of someone who lacks the courage to confront me directly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where the hell is Lucita? You're c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the hell is Lucita? You're carrying out the orders of someone who lacks the courage to confront me directly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where the hell is Taddeus? You're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the hell is Taddeus? You're carrying out the orders of someone who lacks the courage to confront me directly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where the hell is Angelica? You're..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where the hell is Angelica? You're carrying out the orders of someone who lacks the courage to confront me directly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stand down. I'm not here to fight.""
entries.dialogueText: "Stand down. I'm not here to fight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I remained silent, fixing them with..."
entries.dialogueText: I remained silent, fixing them with a steady gaze.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "None of the soldiers reacted."
entries.dialogueText: None of the soldiers reacted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards within the palace reluct..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards within the palace reluctantly dropped their weapons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At that moment, the stable doors bu..."
entries.dialogueText: At that moment, the stable doors burst open with a thunderous crash, and two regal horses galloped wildly through the palace gardens.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Soldier! Lower that gun at once! Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldier! Lower that gun at once! You're pointing your weapon at your king!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go ahead. Shoot me. You can pry my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead. Shoot me. You can pry my crown from my cold dead hands!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soon after, an ear-splitting explos..."
entries.dialogueText: Soon after, an ear-splitting explosion shattered the tranquility of the courtyard, plunging the rebel soldiers into a panic as a thick cloud of smoke engulfed them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hurled myself back inside as guns..."
entries.dialogueText: I hurled myself back inside as gunshots erupted from every direction.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Stop! I surrender. Guards, drop yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Stop! I surrender. Guards, drop your weapons!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Guards! Open fire!""
entries.dialogueText: "Guards! Open fire!"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But first, I need to escort you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But first, I need to escort you to a secure location."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards insisted on escorting me..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards insisted on escorting me to a safe room before initiating the attack.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What? No!""
entries.dialogueText: "What? No!"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What? No!""
entries.dialogueText: "What? No!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There's no time. Open fire immedia..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's no time. Open fire immediately!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I heeded their pleas and followed t..."
entries.dialogueText: I heeded their pleas and followed them to the safe room.
entries.menuText: Follow them to the safe room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have no time. Open fire immedia..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have no time. Open fire immediately!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Lead the way.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Lead the way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded and gave a series of hand..."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded and gave a series of hand signals.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "A thunderous barrage erupted as my..."]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards, displaying utmost profe..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards, displaying utmost professionalism, saluted me before taking firing positions around the windows, their guns aimed at the rebels below.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A thunderous barrage erupted as my..."
entries.dialogueText: A thunderous barrage erupted as my guards started firing at the soldiers below.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "A thunderous barrage erupted as my..."]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I threw myself to the floor as an e..."
entries.dialogueText: I threw myself to the floor as an ear-splitting explosion engulfed the courtyard.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hearing my orders, the guards opene..."
entries.dialogueText: Hearing my orders, the guards opened fire below.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we rushed through corridors and..."
entries.dialogueText: As we rushed through corridors and descended a back stairwell, the sound of gunshots reverberated from outside.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "I threw myself to the floor as an e..."]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother looked at me in shock as..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother looked at me in shock as the chaos unfolded around us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus seized my arm and dragged me..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus seized my arm and dragged me out of the room, rushing me through the palace corridors.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father! What do we do?""
entries.dialogueText: "Father! What do we do?"

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Romus! What do we do?""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus! What do we do?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nearby guards dragged me out of the..."
entries.dialogueText: Nearby guards dragged me out of the room, rushing me through the palace corridors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It wasn't until we were deep within..."
entries.dialogueText: It wasn't until we were deep within the bowels of the palace that the clamor of the battle above gradually subsided.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We could still hear the exchange of..."
entries.dialogueText: We could still hear the exchange of gunfire from outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a simple, fortified space de..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a simple, fortified space devoid of any luxury, designed solely for one purpose...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, we came to a heavy met..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, we came to a heavy metal door -- the entrance to the safe room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We've got to get you to safety. Le..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've got to get you to safety. Let's go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Take cover! We'll wait here until..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take cover! We'll wait here until the situation stabilizes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is out of our hands now. We mus..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is out of our hands now. We must pray."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, just as the captain extend..."
entries.dialogueText: However, just as the captain extended his hand toward the handle, a sudden, resounding crash reverberated through the passages.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind us, we heard someone shout,..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind us, we heard someone shout, "Everyone down on the ground!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Glancing back, I saw a group of reb..."
entries.dialogueText: Glancing back, I saw a group of rebels, each concealed behind a mask, aiming their KA-74's at us with deadly precision.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "With no options left, I pressed my..."
entries.dialogueText: With no options left, I pressed my face to the cold floor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I remained still, locking eyes with..."
entries.dialogueText: I remained still, locking eyes with them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The rebels moved with quick steps,..."
entries.dialogueText: The rebels moved with quick steps, pinning us down, their boots heavy against the backs of our necks. And with a clink of their handcuffs, they secured our wrists.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina and my mother threw themselves..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina and my mother threw themselves to the ground. There was fear in their eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother threw herself to the grou..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother threw herself to the ground. There was fear in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Emboldened by my reaction, Titus tu..."
entries.dialogueText: Emboldened by my reaction, Titus turned toward them, his rifle drawn.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Upon reaching our location, they sw..."
entries.dialogueText: Upon reaching our location, they swiftly subdued and restrained us, securing our wrists with a click of their handcuffs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They confidently brandished their w..."
entries.dialogueText: They confidently brandished their weaponry aloft as a testament to their newfound authority within the palace walls.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This isn't necessary. We're not re..."
entries.dialogueText: "This isn't necessary. We're not resisting!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am not some petty criminal. Rele..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not some petty criminal. Release me from these restraints!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do what you must.""
entries.dialogueText: "Do what you must."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One day, you will pay for this.""
entries.dialogueText: "One day, you will pay for this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ignoring my words, they simply smil..."
entries.dialogueText: Ignoring my words, they simply smiled and escorted us outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Get down or we'll shoot!" one of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get down or we'll shoot!" one of the masked men shouted.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Once again, I refused to comply."
entries.dialogueText: Once again, I refused to comply.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Good news, Your Majesty. Our commu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good news, Your Majesty. Our communications are active again."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've just received word that we've..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've just received word that we've identified collaborators among the rebels as well as their locations. Our forces are ready to respond."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""In the meantime, we must leave the..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, we must leave the palace as soon as the perimeter is secured."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal, Sevrio and a number of Wruhec'..."
entries.dialogueText: Sal, Sevrio and a number of Wruhec's Guardians were huddled in a corner, conversing. They turned back to us.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""I've just been informed that colla..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've just been informed that collaborators among the rebels have been identified, along with their locations."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Wruhec's Guardians stand ready to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec's Guardians stand ready to respond, bringing the wrath of God in their wake."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""We must leave the palace as soon a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must leave the palace as soon as the perimeter is cleared."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""You'll be pleased to know that our..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be pleased to know that our communications are active again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you certain we can clear the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you certain we can clear the perimeter? There were tanks stationed outside the palace!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where will we go?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where will we go?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lord help us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lord help us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""See to it that all who played a pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "See to it that all who played a part in this are brought to justice. Do I make myself clear?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, Your Majesty. I will make sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. I will make sure of it."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Gladly. I'll make sure of it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Gladly. I'll make sure of it."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Halaita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Halaita."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We'll regroup with our armed force..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll regroup with our armed forces, who can provide us with enhanced protection."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""We'll regroup with our armed force..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll regroup with our armed forces, who can provide us with enhanced protection."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My guards are equipped to withstan..."
entries.dialogueText: "My guards are equipped to withstand a professional force significantly larger than their own."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Wruhec's Guardians are capable of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec's Guardians are capable of resisting a professional force much larger than their size."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""This includes anti-tank and anti-a..."
entries.dialogueText: "This includes anti-tank and anti-air capabilities. I assure you, there's no need for concern."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a few minutes, the clamor fro..."
entries.dialogueText: After a few minutes, the clamor from the recent skirmish between the rebels and palace guards outside gradually subsided.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I embraced my mother and daughter...."
entries.dialogueText: I embraced my mother and daughter. Together, we emerged from the safety of our underground stronghold and returned to the surface.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After hugging my mother, we emerged..."
entries.dialogueText: After hugging my mother, we emerged from the safety of our underground stronghold, returning to the surface together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The guards informed us that the per..."
entries.dialogueText: The guards informed us that the perimeter was momentarily secured and that we had a window of opportunity to evacuate the palace. It was now or never.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we stepped into the courtyard, I..."
entries.dialogueText: As we stepped into the courtyard, I beheld the once immaculate garden strewn with the scattered remnants of armored vehicles.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ground was littered with bodies..."
entries.dialogueText: The ground was littered with bodies, shattered weapons, and fragments of uniforms, making it difficult to navigate without stepping on them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before long, our escort brought us..."
entries.dialogueText: Before long, our escort brought us to an armored truck that would transport us to safety.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Despite surviving tonight's attack,..."
entries.dialogueText: Despite surviving tonight's attack, I knew this was just the beginning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The culprit behind it all was still..."
entries.dialogueText: The culprit behind it all was still out there.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without a moment of hesitation, he..."
entries.dialogueText: Without a moment of hesitation, he discharged his firearm.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Narrator: "Without a moment of hesitation, he..."]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stepped outside my chambers and a..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped outside my chambers and alerted two Golden Guard sentries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of a sudden, the doors swung op..."
entries.dialogueText: All of a sudden, the doors swung open, and several Golden Guardsmen hurried in, visibly relieved to see me.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Wruhec's Guardians have taken thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wruhec's Guardians have taken their positions and are prepared to defend the palace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And her unprecedented speech was no..."
entries.dialogueText: And her unprecedented speech was now making headlines in Rizia, sparking questions about our position in the event of a conflict.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will speak to these traitors at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will speak to these traitors at once. I refuse to cower in fear!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus clenched his jaw, his muscles..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus clenched his jaw, his muscles tensing with determination. After a second, he reluctantly nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Understood, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mother's complexion paled noticeabl..."
entries.dialogueText: Mother's complexion paled noticeably as she regarded the armored vehicles outside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will address these traitors at o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will address these traitors at once. I refuse to cower in fear!"

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""What are you going to do?""
entries.dialogueText: "What are you going to do?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The armored vehicle had been oblite..."
entries.dialogueText: The armored vehicle had been obliterated, leaving behind a scene of blood and metal strewn across the cobblestone. My would-be usurper disappeared into the haze, surrounded by a cordon of guards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In response, the rebels surged forw..."
entries.dialogueText: In response, the rebels surged forward, their determined strides echoing through the halls as they breached the once-secure threshold of the palace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The door shut behind us with a defi..."
entries.dialogueText: The door shut behind us with a definitive clang, sealing us off from the outside world.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Survival."
entries.dialogueText: Survival.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We must avoid any other encounters..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must avoid any other encounters with the rebels until loyalist troops can intervene."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""We must avoid any other encounters..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must avoid any other encounters with the rebels until loyalist troops, guided by Divine providence, can intervene."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was no telling when the enemy..."
entries.dialogueText: There was no telling when the enemy would regroup and return for another assault.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sheets felt clammy against my s..."
entries.dialogueText: The sheets felt clammy against my skin, and the soft glow of the moon through the curtains offered no solace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Every creak of the floorboards and..."
entries.dialogueText: Every creak of the floorboards and rustle of the wind outside seemed to amplify in the stillness of the night, further unsettling my restless mind.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I tossed and turned all night. Desp..."
entries.dialogueText: I tossed and turned all night. Despite my utter exhaustion, sleep eluded me entirely.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sheets felt clammy against my s..."
entries.dialogueText: The sheets felt clammy against my skin, and the soft glow of the moon through the curtains offered no solace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Each creak of the floorboards and r..."
entries.dialogueText: Each creak of the floorboards and rustle of the wind outside seemed to amplify in the stillness of the night, setting off alarms in my head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They were coming for me. Or were th..."
entries.dialogueText: They were coming for me. Or were they?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno had abandoned his usual resti..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno had abandoned his usual resting spot and was pacing back and forth in front of the door, as he'd begun doing every night since my mother's warning.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the hope of distracting myself,..."
entries.dialogueText: In the hope of distracting myself, I got out of bed and made my way through the palace corridors to my study.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had told Pabel to lay low on his..."
entries.dialogueText: I had told Pabel to lay low on his estate until the threat blew over. The palace felt empty without him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had told Pabel to lay low at a fr..."
entries.dialogueText: I had told Pabel to lay low at a friend's place in the capital until the threat blew over. The palace felt empty without him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita had called me from the hospi..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita had called me from the hospital, telling me she had experienced some premature contractions and was being kept overnight for observation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus!""
entries.dialogueText: "Titus!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "All of a sudden, the doors swung op..."
entries.dialogueText: All of a sudden, the doors swung open and Titus hurried in, visibly relieved to see me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The doors swung open and Captain Go..."
entries.dialogueText: The doors swung open and Captain Gordion burst in.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. Forgive me. They sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Forgive me. They surrounded us before we could--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he stared out the window, Titus'..."
entries.dialogueText: As he stared out the window, Titus' eyes widened in horror. I followed his gaze to the flag mounted on the lead vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wearing puzzled expressions, the gu..."
entries.dialogueText: Wearing puzzled expressions, the guards gestured outside. I followed their gaze to the flag mounted on the lead vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With an abrupt thud, the doors open..."
entries.dialogueText: With an abrupt thud, the doors opened and Titus rushed in.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Your Majesty. Forgive me. They sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Forgive me. They surrounded us before we could--"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Wait. Is that what I think it is?""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Is that what I think it is?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Nothing. The signal's gone dead.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing. The signal's gone dead."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I will, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Of course, Your Majesty. I'll be b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty. I'll be back in an instant."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: ""Yes, Your Majesty," the guards sho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty," the guards shouted as they rushed out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus bowed and rushed out."
entries.dialogueText: Titus bowed and rushed out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is my wife we're talking abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is my wife we're talking about. I'm sure we can reach an understanding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is my uncle we're talking abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is my uncle we're talking about. I'm sure we can reach an understanding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is my cousin we're talking ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is my cousin we're talking about. I'm sure we can reach an understanding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Just get me out of here. Now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Just get me out of here. Now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Right away, sir. Follow me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Right away, sir. Follow me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus is going to get us all out o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus is going to get us all out of here alive. Aren't you, Captain?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Guards! Get us out of here.""
entries.dialogueText: "Guards! Get us out of here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My protectors nodded their assent a..."
entries.dialogueText: My protectors nodded their assent and motioned for us to follow them to the safe room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My mother watched in wordless terro..."
entries.dialogueText: My mother watched in wordless terror as I grabbed a coat and stepped out onto the balcony.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus cast an agitated glance my wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus cast an agitated glance my way, waiting for my instructions.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get me in contact with Lucita. If..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get me in contact with Lucita. If my wife knew about this, she'd put an end to it immediately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A hush suddenly came over the crowd..."
entries.dialogueText: A hush suddenly came over the crowd. The people below me parted ways as a heavily armored car slowly made its way through the throng.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It rolled over the garden's succule..."
entries.dialogueText: It rolled over the garden's succulents and rose bushes with a series of sickening crunches before coming to a halt in front of the palace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers formed a protective ci..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers formed a protective circle around the vehicle. The back door opened, and Rico stepped out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers formed a protective ci..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers formed a protective circle around the vehicle. The back door opened, and Hugo stepped out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers formed a protective ci..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers formed a protective circle around the vehicle. One of them opened the back door, and Lucita stepped out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers formed a protective ci..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers formed a protective circle around the vehicle. One of them brought a wheelchair around to the back door and helped General Taddeus into it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The soldiers formed a protective ci..."
entries.dialogueText: The soldiers formed a protective circle around the vehicle. One of them opened the back door, and Angelica Sazon stepped out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw profound regret etched onto m..."
entries.dialogueText: I saw profound regret etched onto my uncle's face.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hugo. You don't have to do this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hugo. You don't have to do this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My cousin looked up at me in grim s..."
entries.dialogueText: My cousin looked up at me in grim satisfaction.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ricardus. Listen to me. You don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ricardus. Listen to me. You don't have to do this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By order of the King, you and your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By order of the King, you and your men will stand down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I spit off the balcony, aiming for..."
entries.dialogueText: I spit off the balcony, aiming for Rico's face. His guards shielded him.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Please, cousin. Just cooperate. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, cousin. Just cooperate. It'll be so much easier that way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've gotten my attention. What d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've gotten my attention. What do you want?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Believe me, Romus. I wish there wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, Romus. I wish there was another way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By order of the King, you and your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By order of the King, you and your men will stand down."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please, Romus... I urge you to coo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Romus... I urge you to cooperate. You must know you're outnumbered."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've gotten my attention. What d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've gotten my attention. What do you want?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I want what is best for our house,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want what is best for our house, Romus. Please just cooperate with us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You bastard. This was your plan al..."
entries.dialogueText: "You bastard. This was your plan all along, wasn't it?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put a protective hand over her..."
entries.dialogueText: She put a protective hand over her belly as she looked up at me. I saw sadness in her eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes were stone cold as she loo..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes were stone cold as she looked up at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come on, Luce. You don't have to d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come on, Luce. You don't have to do this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you ever love me?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did you ever love me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Bitch. Traitor. You'll burn in hel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bitch. Traitor. You'll burn in hell for this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have my attention. What do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have my attention. What do you want?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm sorry, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Romus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She briefly looked away."
entries.dialogueText: She briefly looked away.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Please just cooperate. It'll be ea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please just cooperate. It'll be easier for all of us."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Watch your mouth, Toras.""
entries.dialogueText: "Watch your mouth, Toras."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I believe my men have already told..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe my men have already told you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't have to do this, Lucita.""
entries.dialogueText: "You don't have to do this, Lucita."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Neither do you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Neither do you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By order of the King, you and your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By order of the King, you and your men will stand down."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your orders mean nothing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your orders mean nothing."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""If you know what's best for you, y..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you know what's best for you, you'll cooperate."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked up at me, his eyes stern."
entries.dialogueText: He looked up at me, his eyes stern.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't usurp me. You can't even..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't usurp me. You can't even walk!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've gotten my attention. What d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've gotten my attention. What do you want?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""General. You don't have to do this.""
entries.dialogueText: "General. You don't have to do this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By order of the King, you and your..."
entries.dialogueText: "By order of the King, you and your men will stand down."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Even half an Azaro is twice the ki..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even half an Azaro is twice the king you'll ever be, Toras."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My men have already told you. Fors..."
entries.dialogueText: "My men have already told you. Forsake your title and cede the throne to House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please just cooperate with us.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please just cooperate with us."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your orders don't mean anything an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your orders don't mean anything anymore."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The time for bargaining is over, T..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time for bargaining is over, Toras."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Cooperate with us, and you will be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cooperate with us, and you will be spared."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need your word that you won't hu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need your word that you won't hurt my family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You couldn't even handle Iza. What..."
entries.dialogueText: "You couldn't even handle Iza. What makes you fit to rule over a whole kingdom?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need your word that you won't hu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need your word that you won't hurt my family."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Don't be ridiculous. Your family i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be ridiculous. Your family is my family."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""We won't even lay a finger on your..."
entries.dialogueText: "We won't even lay a finger on your husband. Wife? Whatever you people call it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Was this Hugo's idea?""

entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Your Majesty. Forgive me. They sur..."

entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Wait. Is that what I think it is?""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Is that what I think it is?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As he stared out the window, Sevrio..."
entries.dialogueText: As he stared out the window, Sevrio's eyes widened in horror. I followed his gaze to the flag mounted on the lead vehicle.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Lord save us. The radio signal's g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lord save us. The radio signal's gone dead."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Yes, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Yes, Your Majesty. I'll be back in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. I'll be back in an instant."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio bowed and rushed out."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio bowed and rushed out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio paled."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio paled.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Good luck, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio muttered a prayer as he awai..."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio muttered a prayer as he awaited my instructions.

entries.speaker: Sevrio Castellanus
entries.title: Sevrio Castellanus: ""Your Majesty, I really must insist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I really must insist on escorting you to a safe place before initiating anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine. Get me to the safe room.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. Get me to the safe room."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sevrio reluctantly signaled to his..."
entries.dialogueText: Sevrio reluctantly signaled to his guards to drop their weapons.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alongside them were a pair of vans..."
entries.dialogueText: Alongside them were a pair of vans bearing the Palantor Security Solutions logo. Rusty's men.
